command: for d in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/qcom,mdss_mdp@ae00000/qcom,mdss_dsi_m2* /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/soc/pinctrl@f000000; do echo "NODE $d"; for f in "$d/phandle" "$d/compatible" "$d/#gpio-cells" "$d/qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-name" "$d/qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-type" "$d/qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-width" "$d/qcom,mdss-dsi-panel-height"; do test -f "$f" || continue; echo "PROP $f"; od -An -v -tx1 "$f"; done; done; getprop sys.boot_completed
